description: This file defines a utility function getSupabaseClient that initializes and returns a Supabase client instance using environment variables. It includes logic for handling missing environment variables and errors during client creation, along with logging relevant warnings or errors.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client if the required environment variables are present; otherwise, returns null. Handles errors during client creation and logs appropriate messages.
